mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.collision_no, d.request_id, d.third_order_no, d.inst_id, COALESCE(d.inst_code, i.inst_code) AS inst_code, i.inst_name, d.product_id, COALESCE(ip.product_name, d.product_name_snapshot, c.product_name_snapshot) AS product_name, d.precheck_status AS push_status, d.request_log, d.response_log, d.downstream_price, d.product_coefficient_price, d.upstream_channel_price, d.error_msg, d.cost_ms, d.prechecked_at AS pushed_at, d.created_at, c.channel_id, c.channel_code, c.phone_enc, c.user_name AS user_name_enc, c.collision_status, c.reject_reason AS collision_reject_reason, c.settlement_price, ch.channel_name, ch.app_key AS channel_app_key FROM collision_precheck_record d INNER JOIN collision_record c ON c.collision_no = d.collision_no LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = c.channel_id LEFT JOIN institution i ON i.id = d.inst_id LEFT JOIN institution_product ip ON ip.id = d.product_id WHERE d.collision_no = #{collisionNo} ORDER BY d.prechecked_at DESC, d.id DESC
